title: LIVE UPDATES: Marcos in China for 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting (Nov. 20, 2026)
summary: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. is in China for the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting

blocks.text: China's President Xi Jinping (R) shakes hands with Philippines' President Ferdinand Marcos Jr before leaders take a group photo during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China's southern Guangdong Province, on November 19, 2026. GREG BAKER/Pool via REUTERS
Marcos seeks action on illegal, unregulated fishing at APEC
SHENZHEN – President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. raised the matter of illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing during the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
The Philippine leader sought concerted action against questionable fishing practices, according to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO).
Marcos likewise pushed for the digital transformation of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) through artificial intelligence and a charter for a sustainable blue economy,

The president also reaffirmed the Philippines' support for the rules-based multilateral trading system and highlighted the conclusion of the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement under the country’s chairship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) in 2026.
